units.source_text: 催马乐《梅枝》歌词：“黄莺惯宿梅花枝，直到春来不住啼，直到春来不住啼。

en.t: The lyrics of the saibara song "Plum Branch" say: "The yellow warbler is used to lodging among the plum blossoms, and until spring comes it keeps on singing, until spring comes it keeps on singing.

units.source_text: 阳春白雪尚飞飞，阳春白雪尚飞飞。”

en.t: Even in the warmth of spring, white snow still goes on fluttering down, even in the warmth of spring, white snow still goes on fluttering down."
